answer: A sybil cluster must fund and maintain many distinct physical nodes, paying real hardware and stake costs, while honest participants earn steady yields. Each agent must stake copper tokens locked to a hardware-attested identity, and reputation only accrues through verified peer attestations that decay if unconfirmed. Any attempt to spin up fake identities creates a detectable ripple in stake flow patterns, and the network quarantines suspicious clusters into an isolated oasis where they earn nothing until proven genuine. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
